summary: Implemented and verified the Okoa customer-facing Laravel frontend and single-product M-PESA purchase journey.
scope: Responsive Blade layout and Okoa branding
Alpine.js catalogue search and category filtering
Safaricom bundle availability and Buy Now flow
Server-validated checkout and Kenyan phone normalization
M-PESA waiting page with safe status polling
Customer-friendly order status and order tracking
Package-code-based product resolution for order display
assumptions: Existing M-PESA and fulfillment services remain authoritative and were reused.
Customer order lookup remains reference-based without account registration.
Legacy transactions without a package code use amount as a compatibility fallback.
